name: Gathern
note: Saudi peer-to-peer vacation-rental platform (founded 2017; CEO Latifah Altamimi). Upper-chest jersey partner of Al-Nassr since 2024 on a three-year deal (SPORTFIVE announcement). Ownership: not established. Press reports (fwdstart, MENAbytes, AltexSoft, August 2025) say Gathern raised a $72m Series B in August 2025 led by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned PIF subsidiary, with STV, Pinnacle Capital, Nuwa Capital and Endeavor Catalyst participating, at a valuation above $266m, ahead of a possible IPO. No source states Sanabil's or any shareholder's stake or control, so no ownership claim is recorded; the sponsor stays not rated yet.
